summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title). CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), and test_control_set_window_title. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading only, so tests and mypy have not been executed.
